run_silk_inference: run SiLK model inference on two images to detect keypoints and descriptors
load_images: load images from file paths and convert them to torch tensors with channel dimensions
get_model: load a SiLK model from checkpoint with configurable outputs and device settings
from_feature_coords_to_image_coords: convert sparse feature coordinates back to image-space coordinates using the model's coordinate mapping
SILK_MATCHER: match descriptors between two images using ratio-test postprocessing with a configurable threshold
